The checker widens the variable, but the IR slot keeps the type its first assignment gave it, so
`$would = "untouched"; flock($h, LOCK_SH, $would);` passed the checker and the backend then refused
the int written into a string slot. The slot type is a whole-frame property.

`string_incdec_locals` already solves exactly this shape for `"9"++`, and says why widening lazily
at the write is not enough: every OTHER read of the slot would have to detach an owned copy out of
the boxed cell, leaking a heap block per read.
